ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportStawkiVat' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportStawkiVat;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportStawkiVat] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @dbts bigint = cast(@@DBTS as bigint) select isnull((select max(naz_CzasModyfikacji) from cdn.Nazwy where naz_gidtyp=624 AND naz_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion),@RowVersion) as [@RowVersion], ( select stawka.naz_gidlp as [@Id], RTRIM(stawka.naz_Nazwa) as [@Name], CAST(CAST(SUBSTRING(stawka.naz_Nazwa,2,10) AS Decimal(15,2))/100 as Decimal(15,4)) as [@Value], ISNULL(SUBSTRING(drukarka.Naz_Opis,r,1),'') as [@MappedVATRate], Case when stawka.naz_Archiwalny = 0 then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsActive], case when LEFT(RIGHT(stawka.naz_nazwa1,10),2) = '00' then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsNotSubjectToTaxation], SUBSTRING(stawka.naz_Nazwa,1,1) as [@Symbol], case when CAST(SUBSTRING(stawka.naz_Nazwa,2,10) AS Decimal(15,2))=0 then SUBSTRING(stawka.naz_nazwa1,11,1) else 0 end as [@ExportDocumentType], case when LEFT(RIGHT(stawka.naz_nazwa1,10),2) = '20' then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsReverseCharge] from cdn.Nazwy stawka left join cdn.Nazwy drukarka on drukarka.Naz_Nazwa1 = (select psa_drukarka from cdn.PicoStanowiska where PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId) AND drukarka.Naz_GIDTyp=2672 left join (select r+1 as r,s from ( select ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Naz_Opis ASC) r,substring(a.Naz_Opis, v.number+1, 1) s from (select Naz_Opis from cdn.Nazwy where Naz_Nazwa1 = (select psa_drukarka from cdn.PicoStanowiska where PSa_ID = @PointOfSaleId) AND Naz_GIDTyp=2672) a join master..spt_values v on v.number < len(a.Naz_Opis) where v.type = 'P' ) b where r % 2 <> 0) S on S.s = SUBSTRING(stawka.naz_Nazwa,1,1) where stawka.naz_gidtyp=624 AND stawka.naz_CzasModyfikacji > @RowVersion
for xml path('VATRate'), type) for xml path('VATRates') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportStawkiVat TO CDNRaport
